name: BUMP! Superbrawl
description:
Welcome to BUMP! Superbrawl, the newest PvP Free To Play game from Ubisoft, where strategic Planning meets explosive action !

BUMP! Superbrawl is a 1v1 action-strategy game set in the utopian City of Arcadia, a vibrant home to mythical deities and legendary creatures from all over the world. Compete in the grand Superbrawl Tournament, where brains and brawn collide for ultimate glory and a shot at fulfilling your mythical purpose in the human world.

A Fresh Take on 1v1 Battles!

Discover a unique mix of fast-paced strategy and chaotic action:

  • Quick Matches, Big Decisions: Engage in explosive 3-minute battles that keep you on your toes.

  • Simultaneous Turns: Plan your moves, anticipate your opponent, and see the action unfold together in real-time!

  • Strategize and Adapt: Outsmart your rivals in time-limited rounds to take control of the arena.

OVER 20 heroes to unlock!

  • Unlock and customize unique heroes inspired by global mythology—from Greek titans to Japanese gods!

  • Each hero brings distinct abilities, including basic, reactive, and passive skills.

  • Build your ultimate trio by combining four archetypes: Brawler, Dasher, Sniper, or Mage.

Every game is unique!

  • Test your adaptability in rotating PvP arenas with unique hazards and layouts!

  • Every match offers new surprises and challenges—no two games are the same.

Rise to glory!

  • Climb the leaderboards, master the Road to Glory, and unlock powerful rewards in the BUMP Pass.

  • Compete in exciting events, challenge your friends, and showcase your skills on BUMP TV.

Are you ready to dominate the Superbrawl Tournament?

Join us on Discord to connect with other players and get the latest updates.

requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10 (64 bit only)
Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 3.9 GHz, AMD FX-4300 3.8 GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (2GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5500XT (4GB)
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 5 GB available space
requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
